rules_primary: If Seattle records at least 1 pass attempt from on or inside New England's 1-yard line in the Seattle vs New England professional football game originally scheduled for Feb 8, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary: The yard line for this market is based on the line of scrimmage at the snap; the quarterback’s dropback depth or release point does not affect settlement. A play counts only if Seattle records an official forward pass attempt; sacks, scrambles, or run plays do not count. A pass attempt still counts even if the play is nullified by penalty, provided the pass attempt is officially recorded in the play-by-play.
